claim: A 1960 population model proves the world will end on 13 November 2026.
caption:
November 13, 2026 is not a confirmed doomsday. The date comes from a 1960 population-growth model—not an observed approaching catastrophe. As birth rates fell, the world’s population stopped following that model’s projections. An old mathematical extrapolation is not a reliable forecast that the world will end.

Source: ScienceDaily / The Conversation, 16 October 2026.
https://www.sciencedaily.com/releases/2026/10/261016070639.htm

AI illustration — not actual footage.

Checked 30 October 2026. AI-assisted research, design and original illustration; independent automated review.
